intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra catches her reflection in her own bronze bracer and tilts her head. The horns tilt with it.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “A stylist once recommended gold caps for my horns. For formal occasions.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I wanted him to stop measuring my head.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “He used calipers. Then he asked whether they come off for cleaning.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I will record that as the first sensible consultation.”

options.labelText: “Gold caps, though? Very imposing. Very *keep your distance*.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “That was his pitch. Nearly word for word.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She lowers her arm and takes one polite step back, out of measuring range.
